d:
A mother protects.
Lux is a young mother who is visiting her boyfriend's family in a well-appointed suburb. The couple is there for a family gathering and to introduce their infant son to his family, and Lux is particularly nervous, having never met these members of the family before.
Lux and Hunter aren't comfortable, but they do their best to blend in and enjoy the day, though Lux feels uneasy around Hunter's sister Kate and her probing questions. But when Lux and her baby have a mishap, the unspoken tensions come out into the open, sending Lux scrambling to protect her baby at all costs.
